subject: Reference pairing: marketplace payments implementation — Clearway Analytics
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@clearway.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Reference pairing: marketplace payments implementation — Clearway Analytics

Hi Alice,

Great speaking yesterday — thanks again for the diligence. As you mentioned, Clearway is in a late-stage procurement window and the implementation team wants to speak to a customer who ran Redwood against high-throughput marketplace payments (large catalog, fast settlement) and who also did a brief technical deep-dive with an integrations lead.

To make the reference call useful we usually:
- Match by industry/use-case (payments marketplace)
- Include an engineering/ops contact and a product/PO
- Keep it to 30–45 minutes (technical + brief customer outcomes)

Would a 30-minute slot next week (Tue/Wed morning PT) work for your team? If so, I can propose two customers that are aligned on scale and instrumentation. I’m attaching a short reference briefing (one-pager + suggested questions) so your team can prep.

Attachment: reference-briefing-deck.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
redwoodinference.com

——
Internal note: looping Marcus and Monica to confirm availability of the two customers and to surface any redlines on contact sharing.

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@clearway.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference pairing: marketplace payments implementation — Clearway Analytics

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — Tue/Wed morning PT works. Ideally we get:
1) An engineering lead who can speak to real latency/throughput numbers and any batching/kv-cache strategies you recommended, and
2) A product/ops PM who can talk about cost delta pre/post Redwood.

We’re Series D, running production in us-west, and procurement will want to confirm SLA history and any historical incidents (brief is fine). If you can share customers with similar stack surface (Postgres + Redis + payment gateways) that’d be perfect.

Proposed times: Tue 12/1 09:00–09:30 PT or Wed 12/2 10:00–10:30 PT. Either works for me — I’ll lock the slot once you confirm.

— Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform & Procurement, Clearway Analytics
alice.nguyen@clearway.ai

On a related note: happy to sign an NDA if that helps surface contact details quicker.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@clearway.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reference pairing: marketplace payments implementation — Clearway Analytics

Hi Alice — great, thanks for the windows. We can do Tue 12/1 09:00–09:30 PT.

Suggested reference panel (both have agreed to short calls previously):
- Samir Patel, Head of Engineering — ShadeCommerce (marketplace that handles multi-seller payouts). Contact: samir@shadecommerce.com
- Katie O'Leary, Director of Payments — BorealPay (payments orchestration + dispute handling). Contact: katie@borealpay.com

Both customers ran Redwood on a mix of token-generation workloads for fraud scoring + small LLM-powered policy checks and moved to a production pipeline with batching and prefix caching enabled. They can speak to:
- Latency at 95th/99th percentiles after optimization
- Cost per 1M tokens before/after quantization and batching
- Lessons from on-prem vs hosted (we’ll keep that differentiation up front)

I’ve attached a short briefing and internal contact sheet for your team’s prep. Marcus — quick ask: can you confirm we’re fine sharing the direct emails on this call? Monica — can you join the call as the technical lead from our side (brief intro + one slide on what to expect)?

Attachments: reference-briefing-deck.pdf, customer-contacts-sheet.csv

If an NDA helps speed things up we can send a one-page mutual NDA; otherwise Samir/Katie are comfortable with a 30-minute intro and a follow-up email thread for details.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once Marcus confirms contact sharing.

Cheers,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

On behalf of Redwood Inference

- We have permission to share Samir and Katie's work emails for reference calls.
- Monica will join the technical portion and can speak to the batching/kv-cache recommendations and the quantization profile we suggested.

Alice — I’ll send a 30-minute calendar invite for Tue 12/1 09:00–09:30 PT and include Zoom + a link to the one-page briefing. I’ve also uploaded the contacts CSV to the secure customer folder (internal) and included the short consent note on how the customers prefer to be engaged.

Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
